body: Orchestrator (DM-189 review) — candidate for the retro, pre-existing on main: the folder registry returns a tracked folder by its stored path without re-resolving it (`findEntry`, src/main/desktop/folderRegistry.ts:215). If a tracked folder is later replaced by a junction/link, `dm:command`, `git:*` and chat handlers follow the link. Low severity (needs same-user file writes; not reachable from the renderer alone). Suggested card: refuse when realpath(stored) !== stored.
